denominator: No market shares extracted; publisher ad-server market only

sources.title: Online-Werbung: Kommission verhängt fast 3 Milliarden Euro Geldbuße gegen Google
sources.locator: Section Googles beherrschende Stellung: publisher ad servers and programmatic buying tools; both EEA-wide

claims.text: 欧州委員会はEEAの出版社向け広告サーバー市場におけるGoogleの支配的地位と、その濫用を認定したと公表した。 / The Commission reports dominance and abuse in the EEA publisher ad-server market.

classification_basis.finding: Attributed Commission finding of dominance and abuse, AT.40670

legal_status.note: Administrative decision; the current appeal and remedy-compliance status is not established by this source.

limitations: Publisher ad servers only. Programmatic buying tools are a separate relevant market; all advertising must not be aggregated into this case.
